name: Chicken Adobo
steps: Marinate the chicken in soy sauce and garlic for at least 20 minutes.
Heat oil in a pot and sear the chicken until lightly browned.
Add the marinade, water, bay leaves, and peppercorns. Bring to a boil.
Lower the heat and simmer for 20-25 minutes until chicken is tender.
Add the vinegar last, let it simmer for another 5 minutes without stirring too much.
Serve hot with steamed rice.
tip: Mas masarap 'to kinabukasan. Pinapahinga ang lasa magdamag sa fridge.

name: Sinigang na Baboy
steps: Boil the pork in water with onion and tomatoes until tender, about 40 minutes.
Add the radish and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the sinigang mix and season with fish sauce.
Add the eggplant and green chili, simmer for 5 more minutes.
Add the kangkong last and turn off the heat once wilted.
Serve hot with rice and extra fish sauce with chili on the side.
tip: 'Wag sobrahan ang sinigang mix, dagdagan na lang ng kamias o sampalok kung gusto mo mas maasim.

name: Pancit Canton
steps: Sauté garlic and onion in oil until fragrant.
Add the meat and cook until browned.
Pour in the broth and soy sauce, bring to a simmer.
Add the carrots and cabbage, cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add the noodles and toss until they absorb the liquid.
Add snow peas last, toss briefly, then serve with calamansi.
tip: Ihanda lahat ng gulay bago simulan. Mabilis lang talaga ang pagluluto nito, walang oras mag-slice mid-cook.

name: Lumpiang Shanghai
steps: Mix the ground pork, carrot, onion, garlic, egg, and spring onion in a bowl.
Season with salt and pepper, mix well.
Scoop a small amount onto a wrapper and roll tightly, sealing the edge with water.
Repeat until the mixture is used up.
Fry in medium heat oil until golden brown and crispy.
Drain on paper towels and serve with sweet chili sauce or banana ketchup.
tip: Gawin sa bulk tapos i-freeze yung hindi pa niluluto. Sagot 'yan pag kailangan mo bigla ng baon.

name: Bicol Express
steps: Sauté garlic and onion in oil until soft.
Add the pork and cook until lightly browned.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer until pork is tender.
Add the shrimp paste and chili, stir well.
Simmer until the sauce thickens.
Serve hot with rice — this one has a real kick, so have water ready.
tip: Kung ayaw mong sobrang anghang, tanggalin muna ang buto ng chili bago ihalo.

name: Kare-Kare
ingredients: 1/4 cup ground rice or rice flour
steps: Boil the oxtail until very tender, about an hour. Reserve the broth.
In a pot, sauté garlic and onion, then add the broth back in.
Stir in the peanut butter and annatto water until the sauce turns orange-brown.
Add the rice flour slurry to thicken the sauce.
Add the vegetables and simmer until just cooked, not mushy.
Serve with bagoong (shrimp paste) on the side and rice.
tip: Ang tunay na bida dito ay ang bagoong sa tabi 'wag kalimutan, mawawalan ng saysay lahat.

name: Chicken Tinola
steps: Sauté garlic, onion, and ginger until fragrant.
Add the chicken and cook until slightly browned.
Pour in the water and fish sauce, bring to a boil.
Simmer until chicken is cooked through, about 20 minutes.
Add the chayote and simmer until soft.
Add the malunggay leaves last and turn off the heat once wilted.
tip: Gamitin ang tubig-hugasan ng bigas kesa plain water, mas malalim ang lasa ng sabaw.

name: Sisig
ingredients: 500g pork belly and pork face, boiled then grilled
steps: Boil the pork until tender, then grill briefly for char and smokiness.
Chop the grilled pork into small bits.
In a hot pan or sizzling plate, toss the chopped pork with onion and chili.
Season with calamansi, soy sauce, salt, and pepper.
Mix in mayonnaise if using, for creaminess.
Top with a raw or fried egg and serve immediately while sizzling.
tip: Kailangan talaga mainit pagsilbihan. Nawawala ang bongga pag lumamig na.

name: Ginataang Gulay
steps: Sauté garlic, onion, and ginger until fragrant.
Add the shrimp if using, cook briefly.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer.
Add the squash first since it takes longer to cook.
Add the string beans once squash is nearly tender.
Season with fish sauce and simmer until vegetables are cooked through.
tip: Dahan-dahan lang sa pag-simmer, kapag pinakuluan nang malakas hihiwalay ang taba ng gata.

name: Pinakbet
steps: Sauté garlic, onion, and tomatoes until soft.
Add the pork and cook until lightly browned.
Stir in the shrimp paste and a splash of water.
Add the squash first, cover and simmer until half-cooked.
Add the rest of the vegetables and simmer until just tender.
Serve immediately, the vegetables should still have a bit of bite.
tip: Mas masarap pag may bagoong isda pa ring buo, hindi lang yung sabaw nito.

name: Arroz Caldo
ingredients: 1/2 kg chicken, cut into small pieces
Toppings: fried garlic, spring onion, calamansi, boiled egg
steps: Sauté garlic, onion, and ginger until fragrant.
Add the chicken and cook until lightly browned.
Add the rice and stir for a minute to coat it in the aromatics.
Pour in the water or broth and bring to a boil.
Lower heat and simmer, stirring occasionally, until rice is soft and porridge-like.
Season with fish sauce and serve topped with fried garlic, spring onion, and calamansi.
tip: Perfect 'to pag may sipon sa bahay. Dagdagan ng luya, dagdag comfort din.

name: Turon
steps: Roll the banana (and jackfruit if using) in brown sugar until coated.
Wrap in a lumpia wrapper, sealing the edges with a bit of water.
Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Fry the rolls until golden brown and the sugar caramelizes on the outside.
Drain on paper towels before serving to avoid a sugar-burnt tongue.
Best eaten warm, on its own or with ice cream.
tip: Medium heat lang, mabilis masunog ang asukal bago pa maluto ang loob kung malakas ang apoy.

name: Biko
steps: Steam or boil the glutinous rice until just cooked.
In a pan, combine coconut milk, brown sugar, and a pinch of salt. Simmer until it thickens slightly.
Fold in the cooked rice and mix well over low heat until the mixture is sticky and evenly coated.
Transfer to a tray and press down evenly.
Separately, cook the coconut cream until it turns into golden latik curds.
Top the biko with the latik before serving, sliced into squares.
tip: Ang latik ang sikreto dito. Huwag padaanin lang, ubusin talaga hanggang gumolden.
